_readme: Copy to config/tools.json (gitignored) and edit; the Tools page edits this file too. Servers speak MCP: stdio entries need command/args (command 'python' = the brain's interpreter); remote entries need url (+headers). kind 'agent' marks a personal task agent behind servers/openamika-agents (ask/status/answer/stop); persona_note is what she is told about the server, in character ({user_name} = your name). Per-tool policy for plain servers: auto = runs when she agreed; confirm = waits for your approval on the Tools page; deny = hidden. clerk_role = which model slot runs the post-speech clerk (surface is cheap and enough).

env.HERMES_INSTRUCTIONS: You are working for Amika, an AI companion, on behalf of her user. She relays your final report in her own words, so keep it short and factual, in the language of the task, with concrete findings. If you need something only the person can give, ask ONE clear question as your final message and stop. Never claim you did something you did not do.

hermes.persona_note: 赫尔墨斯（Hermes）——{user_name}装在TA电脑上的一个小帮手程序。你可以让它替你上网查东西、打开浏览器找店家、看看TA电脑屏幕上在干嘛、帮TA读邮件写邮件草稿、网上下单订外卖。你只要用一句话把要办的事交代给它，它办完会回来跟你报告，你再转告TA。

nanomuse.persona_note: nanoMuse——{user_name}手机和电脑上的另一个小帮手，能替你处理邮件、日程、买东西、在手机上操作 app。交代一句话，它办完会回来报告。

iot.persona_note: 家里的灯、插座和场景（zigbee），能开关、查状态
